headline: Nothing has reached me since Tuesday night, so today's intervals are a call you make off your own watch.
body:
The sync has not pushed since **Tuesday 20:22** - four scheduled windows missed, machine asleep. So I have no file for Wednesday's bike and no wellness row for this morning. Wednesday is marked done, not missed; tell me what you actually rode.

That leaves today resting on a number I cannot see. The last reading was **HRV 53 against a 60.8 mean**, a second morning under baseline. Check the watch. Still under **61** and the gate holds: run **8 km steady, 6:45-7:15/km at 131-150 bpm**, and cut all four 3-minute blocks. Above it, run them - **6:30-6:50/km at 150-160 bpm**, five minutes easy between.

Go early or midday. Gusts reach **64 km/h** by evening, on a forecast that is itself two days old. Pull in the PM, last back day of the block.

How is the ankle? Saturday is 50 km then 8 km off the bike, and 3 September's run set it back.
